title: Bluegate AutoPay Authorization Notice Standard: Varying-Amount Notices
content:
A varying-amount notice under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization tells the tenant of a draft amount that differs from the last draft.

**Retired clause — no longer in force.** The former clause under which, for a method with a varying-amount notice period above zero, a draft whose amount differs from the previous successful draft on the same authorization (for example after a rent change or because late fees are due) may be submitted only when the handling date is not earlier than the varying-amount notice date plus the notice period, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis. The clauses below stay in force.

**Counting notice days.** Notice days are calendar days counted from the day after the notice date, and the draft may run on the day the count is reached.

**Content of a notice.** A varying-amount notice states the amount to be drafted and the due date.

**No timely notice.** When no timely notice was sent, the draft for that due date collects only the previous draft amount, and the remainder stays owed for the tenant to pay.

**First drafts.** A first draft on a new authorization is not a varying amount.

**Once per due date.** Each notice type is sent once per due date on an authorization: one varying-amount notice, one expiry reminder, one failed-draft notice and one suspension notice at most for a given due date.

### Counting illustration (hypothetical, 10 notice days)

A notice dated the 1st: the counted days are the 2nd to the 11th, and the count is reached on the 11th.

### Points of judgement

- *Previous draft $120.00, new amount $150.00, no timely notice (hypothetical).* The draft collects $120.00; the $30.00 remainder stays owed for the tenant to pay.
- *The first draft after enrollment is for more than any earlier draft.* It is not a varying amount, because it is the first draft on that authorization.
- *A second varying-amount notice for the same due date on the same authorization.* Not sent; that notice type has already been sent for that due date.

superseded_clauses: For a method whose varying_amount_notice_days is above zero, a draft whose amount differs from the previous successful draft on the same authorization, for example after a rent change or because late fees are due, may be submitted only when the handling date is not earlier than the varying-amount notice date plus varying_amount_notice_days.
